bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
log=/tmp/gace-two-video-docker-diagnosis.log
test -s "$log"
if tail -n 12 "$log" | grep -Eiq 'corepack enable|corepack prepare'; then exit 101; fi
if tail -n 12 "$log" | grep -Eiq 'pnpm install|pnpm@'; then exit 102; fi
if tail -n 12 "$log" | grep -Eiq 'build:gaybbs|esbuild|tsx|tsc'; then exit 103; fi
if tail -n 12 "$log" | grep -Eiq 'COPY|not found'; then exit 104; fi
if tail -n 12 "$log" | grep -Eiq 'FROM|registry|node@'; then exit 105; fi
exit 106
